nota: Single message catalog for the setup (Mac and Windows). docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md is generated from this file by tools/render.mjs. Markers like {NOME} are replaced at run time.

ui.titulo: Setup for the workshop "Agent Orchestration with Claude" · kit {WORKSHOP_VERSION}
ui.instala: I will install and configure, for your user only (no admin needed):
instala_lista: git and Claude Code {CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}, logged in to the Anthropic Console
Node.js {NODE_MIN_MAJOR} or newer, uv (Python) and GitHub CLI
the workshop skills, agents, hooks and statusline
ui.tempo: Estimated time: 10 to 20 minutes. If it stops halfway, run the same command again: steps already done are skipped.
ui.tempo_check: Check mode: I don't install anything, I only check. It takes 2 to 3 minutes.
ui.modo_doctor: Diagnostic mode: I check everything and, if something fails, I ask Claude for an explanation.
ui.modo_desinstalar: Uninstall mode: I undo what this setup installed, based on {MANIFEST}.
ui.modo_sim: --yes mode: I answer "yes" to simple questions. Logins and suggested commands don't run on their own.
ui.a_instalar: Installing. This can take a few minutes…
ui.brew_falhou: Homebrew could not install it, so I use the official download instead.
ui.ise_nova_janela: PowerShell ISE cannot answer the questions of the setup, so I opened the setup in a new PowerShell window. Continue there.
ui.relancar_core: This is PowerShell 7: I am starting the setup again in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (64-bit).
ui.relancar_x86: This is the 32-bit PowerShell (x86): I am starting the setup again in the 64-bit Windows PowerShell 5.1.
ui.ja_a_correr: The setup is already running in another window (PID {PID}). Wait for it to finish, or close that window. If no other setup is running, delete {LOCK} and run the setup again.
ui.tty_fg: Another program took over the terminal. If you see "zsh: suspended", type fg and press Enter: the setup carries on.
ui.final_pronto: Everything is ready for the workshop.
ui.final_avisos: There are {N} warnings above. They don't block the workshop, but read them.
ui.final_voltar: After you fix it, run the same command again. Steps already done are skipped.
ui.final_reiniciar: Close and reopen the terminal (and VS Code) so the new commands are available.
ui.final_check_ok: Check complete: everything is ready for the workshop.
ui.helper_pergunta: Do you want Claude to analyze this error? (estimated cost: less than US$ 0.01)
ui.helper_a_pedir: Asking Claude for an analysis. I only send the log excerpt for this step (no secrets), the system and the versions.
ui.helper_comandos: Suggested commands. I run each one only if you say yes:
ui.helper_sim: --yes mode: I don't run suggested commands without your confirmation.
ui.helper_sem_comandos: Claude did not suggest any commands.
ui.helper_falhou: I couldn't get Claude's analysis. Showing the pre-written help.
ui.doctor_sem_claude: Claude is not available (it is not installed or not logged in). Follow the pre-written help for each step.
ui.desinst_settings_limpo: settings.json changed after the install: I removed only the workshop keys.
ui.desinst_memorias: Your memories in {CAMINHO} were left untouched. Delete the folder by hand only if you no longer need them.
ui.desinst_perfil_falhou: I couldn't remove the workshop PATH lines from {FICHEIRO}, so I left it as it was. Delete the lines from '# >>> workshop-claude >>>' to '# <<< workshop-claude <<<' by hand.
ui.desinst_projeto_mantido: Project kept because it has your changes: {CAMINHO}. Delete it by hand if you want.
ui.desinst_fim: Uninstall complete. Still installed: git, Claude Code, Node, uv, gh and the backups in {BACKUP}.
ui.desinst_sem_manifest: I couldn't find {MANIFEST}. There is nothing from the workshop to undo.
ui.s0_lingua_ignorada: WORKSHOP_LANG={VALOR} is not one of the workshop languages (pt-BR, pt-PT, en, hi or he), so I ignored it and used {LINGUA}.
ui.s0_lingua_guardada: Kept the language chosen at install ({LINGUA}); this computer is in {MAQUINA}. To change it, run the setup again with WORKSHOP_LANG (pt-BR, pt-PT, en, hi or he; see "Languages" in the README).
ui.s0_gerido: Company-managed Claude Code settings: {CAMINHO}. Normal on company laptops. If a workshop step is blocked, show code E-CFG-01 to IT.
ui.s0_tls_corp: TLS interception detected (issuer: {EMISSOR}). I exported the company certificates to {CA}.
ui.s0_appdata_rede: Your AppData folder is on a network share ({CAMINHO}). uv keeps the Python and the tools of the Agent Memory app in {LOCAL} instead.
ui.s0_proxy_ntlm: The proxy only lets programs through with your Windows login (NTLM or Kerberos). Claude Code, Node and uv cannot send it, so they will get error 407.
ui.s3_pergunta_login: Log in to the Console now? This opens the browser.
ui.s3_pergunta_trocar: You are logged in with a claude.ai subscription. The workshop uses the Console (pay per use). Switch to the Console?
ui.s3_login_sim: --yes mode: I don't do interactive logins.
ui.s3_sem_tty: This window is not an interactive terminal (an AI agent, an IDE task or a script), so the setup cannot log you in here. Open a normal terminal window (Terminal on Mac, PowerShell on Windows) and run the same setup command there.
ui.s4_terminal_sem_resposta: Could not check which Node a new terminal finds: your shell startup files (~/.zprofile, ~/.zshrc) did not answer within {SEGUNDOS} s, or they start another program (such as tmux). Open a new terminal and check with node -v: it should show v{NODE_MIN_MAJOR} or later.
ui.s6_pergunta_login: Log in to GitHub now? (opens the browser)
ui.s6_sem_login: gh installed, not logged in to GitHub.
ui.s7_oauth: To finish: open Claude Code, type /mcp, choose atlassian and log in in the browser.
ui.s7_pergunta_acli: Log in to the Atlassian CLI now? It is the Jira backup for when the MCP fails. (opens the browser; answer n if you don't use Jira)
ui.s7_acli_login: Jira backup: if the MCP fails, run acli auth login in a terminal (opens the browser).
ui.s8_statusline_mantida: You already had a statusline. I kept yours. To use the workshop one, run the setup with {FLAG_STATUSLINE}.
ui.s8_lingua_nossa: Claude answers in {NOME} (Claude Code "language" setting). Workshop texts: {KIT}.
ui.s8_lingua_tua: You already had a "language" setting ({NOME}): I kept it. Workshop texts: {KIT}.
ui.s8_lingua_nenhuma: No "language" setting for {LINGUA}: Claude answers in the language you write in. Workshop texts: {KIT}.
ui.s8_lingua_muda: Language installed here: {DE}. This run asks for {PARA} (WORKSHOP_LANG): nothing is broken. Run the full setup (without --check) to switch.
ui.s9_sem_testes: The project doesn't have test/app.test.js yet. I skipped the tests.
ui.s9_lingua_diferente: {CAMINHO} is in {LINGUA}, and the workshop texts are now in {KIT}. I left it as it was, with your work. To have it in {KIT}: rename that folder and run the setup again (it builds a new one; the renamed folder keeps your work).
ui.s10_ok: Agent Memory app {VERSAO} (Python {PY} managed by uv, FTS5 ok)
ui.s10_update: To update the app later: agent-memory update. On Windows, close Claude Code first; the update finishes in a new PowerShell window.
ui.s11_aviso: Claude Desktop only signs in with a claude.ai account, and the Code tab needs a subscription. All the workshop hands-on work runs in Claude Code (terminal).
ui.s12_prompt: Reply in English with only the word OK
ui.s12_custo_desconhecido: model has no price in pricing.json
ui.interrompido: Interrupted. Run the same command again: steps already done are skipped.
ui.s1_portatil: git {VERSAO} (the workshop's portable git, without the Apple tools)

E-SETUP-01.titulo: This step is not done yet
E-SETUP-01.causa: The setup has not installed this on this computer yet, or the install stopped halfway.
fazer: Run the full setup, without --check. Steps already done are skipped.

E-NET-01.causa: The network does not let you reach one or more domains that the workshop needs. This is usually a company firewall or filter.
fazer: Ask your IT team to allow the domains listed in docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md (section "Required domains").
Or use another network (for example, your phone's hotspot) and run the setup again.

E-NET-02.titulo: The server name does not resolve (DNS)
E-NET-02.causa: The computer can't translate the domain name into an address. The network may require a VPN, or DNS is failing.
fazer: Connect to the company VPN if you use one, or disconnect it if it is blocking.
Try another network and run the setup again.

E-NET-03.titulo: The proxy asks for authentication or is misconfigured
E-NET-03.causa: The network only goes out through a proxy, and the request was refused (for example, error 407).
fazer: Set the proxy for this session and run the setup again.
If the proxy asks for a username and password, ask IT for a proxy without authentication or an exception for the workshop domains.
On Windows, if even the first command of the setup gets error 407, run it with the last command: it sends your Windows login to the proxy.

E-NET-04.titulo: Your company intercepts HTTPS traffic (its own certificate)
E-NET-04.causa: The certificate for api.anthropic.com does not come from a public authority. The company network opens the traffic and encrypts it again. The setup exports the company certificates to ~/.workshop-claude/ca.pem and configures Claude Code to use them.
fazer: Usually you don't need to do anything: the setup already set NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and UV_SYSTEM_CERTS.
If the final test fails with a certificate error, ask IT for the company root certificate in PEM format and save it to ~/.workshop-claude/ca.pem. Then run the setup again.
windows: Get-ChildItem Cert:\LocalMachine\Root, Cert:\CurrentUser\Root | Select-Object Subject, Issuer

E-NET-05.titulo: No connection to the Anthropic API
E-NET-05.causa: Claude Code can't talk to api.anthropic.com. Without this there is no workshop, and Claude can't help you diagnose the problem either.
fazer: Check that you can open https://api.anthropic.com in the browser (a JSON error page means you can reach it).
If you use a proxy, set HTTPS_PROXY before you run the setup.
Ask IT to allow api.anthropic.com, claude.ai and platform.claude.com.

E-NET-06.titulo: Proxy with NTLM or Kerberos authentication only
E-NET-06.causa: Claude Code and Node can't authenticate to NTLM or Kerberos proxies. This type of proxy is not supported.
fazer: Ask IT for a proxy exception for the workshop domains.
Or use another network (your phone's hotspot) during the workshop.

E-NET-07.causa: A file was not downloaded, or it arrived incomplete. This is usually a short network failure.
fazer: Run the setup again. Steps already done are skipped.
If it always fails on the same file, check the network and the proxy (codes E-NET-01 and E-NET-03).

E-SO-01.causa: This Windows version is old. winget and Claude Desktop don't work on it, and other things may fail.
fazer: Update Windows with Windows Update, or ask IT.
The setup continues, but uses direct installers instead of winget.

E-SO-02.causa: The computer has an ARM processor. The setup picks the ARM64 versions of Node, gh and Git when they exist.
fazer: You don't need to do anything. If a step fails, tell the organizer and give them the code of this warning.

E-SO-03.titulo: Your home folder is in OneDrive
E-SO-03.causa: Your home folder, or the folder of the workshop projects, is synced by OneDrive. Syncing can lock files while the agents are working.
fazer: During the workshop, pause OneDrive syncing (OneDrive icon > Pause syncing).
The projects are in {PROJETOS}. If that folder is inside OneDrive, move it out.

E-SO-04.causa: Claude Code needs macOS 13 or newer.
fazer: Update macOS in System Settings > General > Software Update.

E-SO-05.causa: PowerShell is in ConstrainedLanguage mode, because of a company policy (AppLocker or WDAC). In this mode the setup can't run.
fazer: Ask IT for an exception for the workshop setup, or do the setup on another computer.
Check the mode with the command below: it must say FullLanguage.

E-SO-06.causa: There are less than 3 GB free in your home folder. The tools and the projects need about 2 GB.
fazer: Free up space (for example, empty the Downloads folder) and run the setup again.

E-SO-07.titulo: A company policy blocks PowerShell scripts
E-SO-07.causa: Group Policy sets the PowerShell execution policy, and it wins over "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass". With AllSigned or Restricted, no unsigned script can run: not the setup, and not the official installers of Claude Code and uv.
fazer: Ask IT for an exception for the workshop (scripts from your user folder), or do the setup on another computer.
If the policy is RemoteSigned and you downloaded setup-windows.ps1 with the browser, unblock the file first (second command) and run it again.

E-SO-08.titulo: PowerShell ISE can't run the setup
E-SO-08.causa: PowerShell ISE has no real console: the programs that ask you something (the Claude Code, GitHub and Jira logins) would wait forever.
fazer: Open "Windows PowerShell" from the Start menu (not "Windows PowerShell ISE") and run the setup command there.

E-CFG-01.causa: Your company installed rules for Claude Code that override yours. They can block workshop models, tools, MCP or hooks.
fazer: If a workshop step is blocked, show this warning to IT.
The file is at the path shown above. Don't change it without talking to IT.

E-CFG-02.causa: With this variable, Claude Code uses that key instead of your login. The cost goes to the account that owns the key.
fazer: If the key is yours and from the Console, you can continue.
If not, remove the variable from your terminal profile and open a new terminal.

E-CFG-03.causa: With this variable, Claude Code talks to another server instead of the Anthropic API (for example, a company gateway). Prices and models may be different.
fazer: If IT asked you to use that gateway, you can continue.
If not, remove the variable and open a new terminal.

E-CFG-04.titulo: Claude Code is set up for Bedrock or Vertex
E-CFG-04.causa: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX is set. Claude Code uses the company cloud, and the Console login is ignored.
fazer: For the workshop, remove the variable and open a new terminal.
If your company requires Bedrock or Vertex, check with the organizer that the workshop models are available.

E-CFG-05.titulo: The Claude Code settings.json file has an error
E-CFG-05.causa: ~/.claude/settings.json is not valid JSON. The setup does not touch it, so you don't lose your settings.
fazer: Open the file and fix the error (for example, a missing comma or brace).
Then run the setup again.

E-CFG-06.causa: Your Claude Code already shows a statusline of your own. The setup kept it and did not install the workshop one, which shows the cost.
fazer: You can continue: the cost also shows in /demo-cost.
To use the workshop statusline, run the setup again with the option below. Yours stays in the backup and comes back with --uninstall.

E-CFG-07.titulo: uv is not allowed to use managed Python
E-CFG-07.causa: An environment variable (UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS, UV_NO_MANAGED_PYTHON or UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE) stops uv from downloading its own Python. The Agent Memory app needs that Python. The setup ignores the variable only in its own command, but other uv commands are still affected.
fazer: If your company set the variable, talk to IT before you change it.
You don't need Python installed: uv brings its own.

E-PERM-01.titulo: No permission to write to your home folder
E-PERM-01.causa: The setup installs everything in your home folder, and a folder is protected or belongs to another user (for example, it was created with sudo or by an administrator).
fazer: Find the folder in the log and fix its owner.
Don't run the setup with sudo or as administrator.

E-PERM-02.titulo: A program was blocked by the computer's security
E-PERM-02.causa: An antivirus, EDR, AppLocker, WDAC or Gatekeeper stopped a program installed in your home folder from running, or removed a file right after the download.
fazer: Show IT the program name from the log and ask for an exception.
On a Mac, if you see "cannot be opened", open System Settings > Privacy & Security and choose "Open Anyway".

E-PERM-03.titulo: The installer asked for administrator permissions
E-PERM-03.causa: An installer tried to write outside your home folder. The setup is built to work without admin.
fazer: Decline the elevation request and run the setup again: it uses the no-admin alternative.
If the problem continues, send the log to the organizer.

E-GIT-01.causa: The Mac does not have Apple's Command Line Tools, and the workshop's portable git is not working.
fazer: Run the setup again: the portable git is downloaded again.
If it still fails, install the Apple tools with the command below (it may ask for the administrator password) and run the setup again.

E-GIT-02.titulo: I couldn't install Git for Windows
E-GIT-02.causa: winget is not available or failed, and the direct Git installer also failed.
fazer: Install Git for Windows by hand, choosing "Only for me" (no admin), and run the setup again.
If your company has a software portal (Company Portal, Software Center), install Git from there.

E-GIT-03.causa: On Windows, Claude Code uses Git Bash to run commands and hooks. git is there, but I couldn't find bash.exe next to it or in the usual Git for Windows folders.
fazer: Reinstall Git for Windows (it includes Git Bash) and run the setup again.
If bash.exe is in another folder, set the variable below to the right path.

E-CC-01.causa: The official installer did not finish. This is usually the network (downloads.claude.ai blocked) or an antivirus blocking the file.
fazer: Check that you can reach claude.ai and downloads.claude.ai (code E-NET-01).
Run the official installer by hand and run the setup again.

E-CC-02.titulo: The claude command is not in the PATH
E-CC-02.causa: Claude Code was installed in ~/.local/bin, but the terminal does not look in that folder yet.
fazer: Close and reopen the terminal. If it still fails, add the folder to the PATH with the command below.

E-CC-03.titulo: The Claude Code version is old
E-CC-03.causa: The workshop needs Claude Code {CLAUDE_CODE_MIN_VERSION} or newer. There may be an old install (for example, from npm) earlier in the PATH.
fazer: Check which claude the terminal uses. If it is an old npm install, remove it.
Then run the setup again.

E-AUTH-01.titulo: Claude Code is not logged in
E-AUTH-01.causa: You have not logged in yet. The workshop uses your Anthropic Console account (pay per use).
fazer: Run the command below. It opens the browser: sign in to the Console and authorize.
If you don't have an account, create one at {CONSOLE_URL} and add credits (Billing).
Then run the setup again.

E-AUTH-02.titulo: The login is a claude.ai subscription, not the Console
E-AUTH-02.causa: You are logged in with a claude.ai subscription (Pro or Max). It works, but the workshop was prepared for the Console and measures cost at API prices.
fazer: You can continue with the subscription: the limits are the ones of your plan.
To use the Console, run the command below.

E-AUTH-03.titulo: Claude Code uses another authentication method
E-AUTH-03.causa: The login comes from an environment variable, a token or a cloud (Bedrock or Vertex), not from the Console.
fazer: If this is intentional, you can continue.
To use the Console, remove that variable, open a new terminal and run the command below.

E-NODE-01.causa: The download from nodejs.org failed, or the file does not match the published SHA256SUMS.
fazer: Check that you can reach nodejs.org (code E-NET-01) and run the setup again.
Or install Node {NODE_VERSION} (LTS) from the official site and run the setup again.

E-NODE-02.titulo: An old or broken Node comes first in the PATH
E-NODE-02.causa: A new terminal finds first a Node older than {NODE_MIN_MAJOR}, or one that does not start. The hooks use the new Node, but the project tests may use the old one.
fazer: Close and reopen the terminal, then see which node comes first with the first command below.
If you use nvm, select the new Node with nvm. If the first node does not start (on a Mac, often a broken Homebrew node), reinstall or remove it: brew reinstall node or brew uninstall node.
Check with node -v.

E-UV-01.causa: The official uv installer failed. This is usually the network (astral.sh or github.com blocked).
fazer: Check that you can reach astral.sh, releases.astral.sh and github.com.
Run the installer by hand and run the setup again.

E-GH-01.causa: The gh download failed or does not match the checksums file of the release.
fazer: Check that you can reach github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com.
Run the setup again. gh is only needed in Project 2 (real task).

E-GH-02.causa: gh is installed but has no account. The workshop needs the GitHub login for Project 2: read issues, create branches and open PRs.
fazer: Run the command below: it opens the browser with a code so you can confirm the login.
If your company uses GitHub Enterprise, replace github.com with the company server.
Then run the setup again.

E-MCP-01.titulo: I couldn't add the Atlassian MCP
E-MCP-01.causa: The claude mcp add command failed. Claude Code may be missing, or your company blocks MCP servers.
fazer: Run the command below by hand and read the error message.
If your company blocks MCP (managed-settings), use the training project with local issues.
mac: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user atlassian {ATLASSIAN_MCP_URL}
windows: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user atlassian {ATLASSIAN_MCP_URL}

E-MCP-02.causa: The Jira MCP is registered, but you must log in yourself, in the browser, from inside Claude Code.
fazer: Open Claude Code, type /mcp, choose atlassian and follow the login.
If the Jira admin restricts domains, ask them to authorize Claude.

E-ACLI-01.titulo: I couldn't install the Atlassian CLI (Jira backup)
E-ACLI-01.causa: The download from acli.atlassian.com failed, or the file does not match the expected SHA-256. acli is only used when the Jira MCP fails, so the setup continues.
fazer: Check that you can reach acli.atlassian.com (the company network may block it).
Run the setup again. Without acli, Jira still works through the MCP (/mcp).

E-ACLI-02.titulo: The Atlassian CLI is not logged in, or the site refused access
E-ACLI-02.causa: acli needs your login. Since version 1.3.15, an Atlassian site administrator must authorize the ACLI app once ("Your site admin must authorize this app…").
fazer: Run acli auth login and, in the terminal, choose the same site you chose in the browser.
If you see "site admin must authorize", ask the Jira administrator to run acli jira auth login, choose "Web" and approve the site.

Alternative without OAuth: create an API token at id.atlassian.com (Security > API tokens), copy it and run the command on the second line. The token goes from the clipboard to acli, without being saved in your history or in files.
mac: pbpaste | acli jira auth login --site <company>.atlassian.net --email <your email> --token
windows: Get-Clipboard | acli jira auth login --site <company>.atlassian.net --email <your email> --token

E-KIT-01.titulo: I couldn't get the workshop kit
E-KIT-01.causa: The download of the kit archive failed, and the fallback git clone failed too.
fazer: Check that you can reach the repository server ({REPO_HOST}).
Run the setup again. If it still fails, send the log to the organizer.

E-KIT-02.titulo: The kit archive does not match (SHA-256)
E-KIT-02.causa: The downloaded file is different from the published one. It may be incomplete, or a proxy changed it.
fazer: Run the setup again to download it again.
If it happens again, stop and tell the organizer.

E-KIT-03.titulo: Installing the skills and hooks failed
E-KIT-03.causa: The Node installer couldn't copy the files or update settings.json. Your settings.json has a backup in ~/.workshop-claude/backup.
fazer: Read the message in the log (search for "install-user").
Fix the cause (permissions or an invalid settings.json) and run the setup again.

E-DEMO-01.titulo: I couldn't set up the workshop projects
E-DEMO-01.causa: Copying the projects or running git init on them failed.
fazer: Read the message in the log (search for "assemble").
If the folder already exists with other content, rename it and run the setup again.

E-DEMO-02.causa: The app's own tests (test/app.test.js) should pass from the start. The card tests are red on purpose.
fazer: Run the tests by hand and send the result to the organizer.
Check that node -v shows version {NODE_MIN_MAJOR} or higher.

E-DEMO-03.titulo: The project folder already exists and is not from the kit
E-DEMO-03.causa: There is already a folder with that name and with other files. The setup does not delete it.
fazer: Rename the folder (or delete it, if you don't need it) and run the setup again.

E-MEM-01.titulo: The Agent Memory app release is not published yet
E-MEM-01.causa: I couldn't find the files for the Agent Memory app {MEMORY_APP_VERSION} on the server. The app is optional: the skills work without it.
fazer: You can continue. Closer to the workshop, run the setup again to install it.

E-MEM-02.titulo: The Agent Memory app file does not match (SHA-256)
E-MEM-02.causa: The downloaded wheel is different from the one published in SHA256SUMS. I did not install it.
fazer: Run the setup again. If it happens again, tell the organizer.

E-MEM-03.titulo: Installing the Agent Memory app failed
E-MEM-03.causa: uv couldn't install the app (Python {PYTHON_VERSION} or the dependencies). This is usually the network (pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org or github.com).
fazer: Check that you can reach pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org.
Run the setup again. The app is optional: the skills work without it.

E-MEM-04.causa: The Agent Memory app window uses Microsoft Edge WebView2, and I couldn't find it or install it. Without it, the app opens in the browser.
fazer: You can continue: the app opens in the browser.
To get the app's own window, install the WebView2 Runtime from your company's software portal, or ask IT.

E-MEM-05.titulo: The Agent Memory app test failed
E-MEM-05.causa: The app is installed, but its self-test failed. The Python that uv installed, the note search (FTS5) or the memories folder is not working. The skills work without the app.
fazer: Run the command below and send the result to the organizer.
Run the setup again: uv reinstalls the app and its Python.

E-DESK-01.titulo: Claude Desktop has limits with the Console
E-DESK-01.causa: Claude Desktop only signs in with a claude.ai account, and the Code tab needs a subscription. All the workshop hands-on work runs in Claude Code (terminal).
fazer: You don't need to do anything. Desktop is optional.

E-DESK-02.causa: The Claude Desktop download or install failed. It is optional.
fazer: If you want it, download it by hand from {DESKTOP_DOWNLOAD_PAGE_URL}.

E-PROF-01.titulo: The setup could not add the workshop folders to a shell profile
E-PROF-01.causa: New terminals read this file when they start, but the setup could not read or change it. It is read-only, belongs to another user (for example, it was created with sudo), or links to a file that is missing or read-only (dotfiles, iCloud). The setup left it as it was. The other profile files were updated.
fazer: Add the first line below at the end of the file the setup named (or of the file it links to in your dotfiles), then open a new terminal.
If the file is not read-only on purpose, check it with the second command, make it readable and writable for you (or ask whoever manages your Mac), and run the setup again.

E-PROF-02.titulo: A shell profile has an incomplete workshop block
E-PROF-02.causa: The file has a '# >>> workshop-claude >>>' line without its '# <<< workshop-claude <<<' line, or the other way round (an old or hand-edited block). The setup did not change the file, so none of your lines were lost. The other profile files were updated.
fazer: Open the file the setup named and delete the old workshop lines: the marker line and the PATH lines that follow it. Keep your own lines.
Then run the setup again.

E-SMOKE-01.causa: Claude Code couldn't answer a simple request. It may be the login, the network or credits.
fazer: Run the command below and read the error message.
Check the login (code E-AUTH-01) and the credits (code E-SMOKE-02).
mac: claude -p "Reply in English with only the word OK" --model claude-haiku-5-5
windows: claude -p "Reply in English with only the word OK" --model claude-haiku-5-5

E-SMOKE-02.titulo: The Console account has no credits
E-SMOKE-02.causa: The API refused the request because the balance is too low (credit balance too low).
fazer: Open {CONSOLE_URL}, go to Billing and add credits (recommended: a limit well above US$ 10).
Then run the setup again.

E-SMOKE-03.causa: The API is limiting the requests from your organization. New accounts have lower limits.
fazer: Wait a minute and run the setup again.

E-SMOKE-04.titulo: The test model is not available in your account
E-SMOKE-04.causa: Your organization has no access to the claude-haiku-5-5 model, or a company gateway blocks it.
fazer: Check the available models in the Console and talk to the organizer.

E-GIT-04.titulo: The portable git download is corrupted
E-GIT-04.causa: The downloaded file does not have the expected SHA-256. A proxy may be changing the download.
fazer: Run the setup again.
If it still fails, try another network and show setup.log to whoever is helping you.
